How to cite the Knowledge Portals

If you would like to cite results from the Knowledge Portals in a scientific publication, please cite 1) the website; 2) a publication on the Portal (if available; see the list below); and 3) the publication(s) for any specific studies that are referred to.

Please cite the Knowledge Portals as follows:

Knowledge Portal name (URL of Portal home page). Name of page accessed. Year/Month/Date of access; URL of page you are citing (RRID of the Portal (see below).

For instance, a user who viewed the T2DKP page on the gene SLC30A8 on February 1, 2020, and wanted to cite it would use this citation:

Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal (type2diabetesgenetics.org). SLC30A8 Gene page. 2020 Feb 1; https://hugeamp.org/gene.html?gene=SLC30A8 (RRID:SCR_003743).
